import tomllib

PYPROJECT = """
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68.0", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "mathutils"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Math utility functions"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
    "numpy",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest",
]
"""

data = tomllib.loads(PYPROJECT)
project = data["project"]

assert project["name"] == "mathutils"
assert project["version"] == "0.1.0"
assert project["requires-python"] == ">=3.10"
assert any(d.startswith("numpy") for d in project["dependencies"])
assert any(d.startswith("pytest") for d in project["optional-dependencies"]["dev"])

print("Valid pyproject.toml with all fields filled")
